purpose: Prespecified aggregate for repeated schema-only query-writer runs. Written before runs C, D and E existed; no C/D/E query or response file was present when this plan was written.
protocol: Runs C and E reuse the run A query-writer prompt and run D reuses the run B prompt for each query language; each run is a fresh context-free subagent that reads one schema packet and writes one query per item without executing anything. Queries are executed once by run_chain_eval.py --queries with no repair rounds for the primary metric.
primaryMetric: Exact row-set match (score_chain_eval.py) on all 667 items of the first submitted query, averaged over the five runs of a method.
primaryInterval: Percentile 95% interval from a cluster bootstrap that resamples the 35 (wg, family) clusters with replacement and keeps every item and every run of a sampled cluster; 10,000 resamples, seed 20261112.
reportedWithPrimary: per-run exact counts on 667, on the 581 answerable items and on the 86 empty-gold items
the same quantities after the recorded repair rounds, labelled as repaired
methodComparison: Difference in mean exact rate between two methods with a paired cluster bootstrap interval over the same 35 clusters. A non-significant difference is reported as an interval and is not read as equivalence.
clusters: (wg, family) using the item fields wg and family; pack_lookup_empty forms its own family cluster.
